However, the finding’s key behavioral claim (“feed polling via `TopicEmbed.import` never checks the host, so non-table hosts will import into no category”) isn’t supported by the diff: `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?` is updated to reject non-allowed hosts via `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?`, and `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` also enforces the same check before embedding.
